description: parkoviště (linie) is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statutární město Jihlava. Line layer of parking spaces. Coverage: Statutární město Jihlava. The portal shows the English title as "parking lot (line)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Statutární město Jihlava. Its keywords include parkování, Parkoviště, Doprava. The listing shows 6 download or service links in KML, MS-EXCEL, JSON, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00286010/e20f2e099370e48ab31282898e8ad134/distribuce/d6b2d1d004b48bd24b4b62a234d64623/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
